goal: Talk about a real weakness honestly and say how you are improving it.

phrases.text: One thing I am working on is ...

meaning.roman: Ek cheez jis par main kaam kar raha/rahi hoon, wo ... hai.

phrases.example: One thing I am working on is speaking in front of groups.

phrases.text: I used to ..., but now I ...

meaning.roman: Pehle main ... karta/karti tha, lekin ab main ... karta/karti hoon.

phrases.example: I used to be shy, but now I speak more in class.

meaning.roman: Behtar hone ke liye, main ... karta/karti hoon.

phrases.example: To improve, I practise speaking English every day.
I am learning to ask for help when I need it.

roleplay.tutor_line: What is one weakness you have?

task.roman: Apni ek asli kamzori imandari se batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: One thing I am working on is speaking in front of groups. I sometimes feel nervous.

roleplay.tutor_line: Has it always been like this?

task.roman: Batayein ke pehle halaat kaise the aur ab kaise hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I used to be very shy, but now I speak more in class.

roleplay.tutor_line: What are you doing to improve?

task.roman: Batayein ke behtar hone ke liye aap kya kar rahe hain.

roleplay.model_answer: To improve, I practise speaking English every day for ten minutes. I also join group discussions.

roleplay.tutor_line: Is there anything else you are trying to learn?

task.roman: Ek aur cheez batayein jo aap seekh rahe hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I am learning to ask for help when I need it. It saves time and I make fewer mistakes.

roleplay.tutor_line: How has working on this helped you?

task.roman: Batayein ke is par kaam karne se aap ko kya faida hua.

roleplay.model_answer: I feel more confident now. I used to avoid speaking, but now I try to speak first.

review_notes: The example weakness is being shy in groups. Is that a safe answer in your market, or should the examples be more work-related (for example, taking on too much work)?
